newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Frenchman shot dead by police in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Frenchman shot dead by police in Australia.

text.p: A knife-wielding man shot dead by police on Sydney's Bondi Beach was a French national living in Australia, police said on Sunday.
The 33-year-old Frenchman died in hospital on Saturday morning after being shot during a dawn confrontation with police on Australia's most famous beach, police said.
The man was shot four times in the chest by two policemen when he rushed at them with a knife, Senior Constable Mark Hargreaves told Reuters.
The Frenchman had been directed to drop the knife several times over a 20-minute confrontation on the beach, during which the man rushed into and then out of the surf, police said.
The name of the Frenchman, who had been living in Australia for a number of years, had not been released and may not be released for some time, Hargreaves said.
The man's estranged wife, who had been living in Melbourne, had been informed.
